reason: Audit 2026-10-22-i1-W1: last_date 2026-03-06 is the 2026 edition, held at SPUR Innovation Centre, Waterloo (hack-canada-2026.devpost.com), not in Toronto. Kept as the last edition of the same event; the description now says where it was held.

set.description: A student hackathon bringing together hackers from universities across Canada, with travel reimbursement and over $10K in prizes. Free to attend for high school and university students. The 2026 edition was held in Waterloo; 2027 moves to the University of Toronto.
